cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time, importlib.util, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import stress, ref, gen
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
doc, cl = stress.build(K=32, nrib=2000, nq=512, qlen=64, nprior=2000, ndecl=2000, count=1000000)
# no declarations, few priors -> queries hit core marginals
doc2 = dict(doc); doc2['declared']=[]; doc2['priors']=[]
raw = json.dumps(doc2).encode()
t=time.time()
p = subprocess_run = __import__('subprocess').run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
print('no-decl time %.2f' % (time.time()-t), p.stdout[:80])
# compute Z explicitly
ixps, rib, priors, declared, order, queries = m._parse(doc2)
agg={}
for path,count in rib:
    n=m._normalize(path,ixps)
    if len(n)<2 or len(set(n))!=len(n): continue
    agg[tuple(n)]=agg.get(tuple(n),0)+count
al, rounds, surv = m._peel(list(agg.items()))
core=set()
for path,_c in surv:
    for i in range(len(path)-1): core.add(m._canon(path[i],path[i+1]))
print('core links', len(core), 'total occurrence count', sum(c for _p,c in [(p,cc) for p,cc in [(pp,q) for pp,q in [(tuple(x),y) for x,y in [(list(z),w) for z,w in [(a,b) for a,b in []]]]]] if False))
fa={}
for p,c in surv: fa[p]=fa.get(p,0)+c
occ=m._occurrences(list(fa.items()), {e:i for i,e in enumerate(sorted(core))}, len(core))
M=[sum(g for g in occ[e].values()) for e in range(len(core))]
print('M_e sample', M[:10], 'max', max(M))
EOF
